title: Antagonism assays to identify bacterial strains producing antimicrobial compounds.
author: Dalia Molina-Romero
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.j4mcqu6

steps.title: Prepare PY‑Ca medium
steps.instruction: Dissolve per liter of distilled water: 5 g peptone, 3 g yeast extract, and 0.7 g calcium chloride; sterilize by autoclaving and cool before use.

steps.title: Grow producer strains in liquid
steps.instruction: Inoculate producer bacteria into PY‑Ca liquid medium and incubate 24 h at 30 °C with shaking at 200 rpm until stationary phase (≈5 × 10⁸ CFU mL⁻¹).

steps.title: Spot producer onto agar plates
steps.instruction: Dispense 200 µL of each producer suspension into a 96‑well microplate, transfer spots onto PY‑Ca agar plates using a multipoint replicator, and incubate 48 h at 30 °C.

steps.title: Remove producer cells and sterilize
steps.instruction: After incubation, remove producer colonies from the agar surface with a sterile glass slide, then expose plates to chloroform vapor for 1 h; keep plates open in a laminar‑flow cabinet until all chloroform has evaporated.

steps.title: Prepare sensitive‑strain suspension
steps.instruction: Grow the potential sensitive strain under the same conditions (24 h, 30 °C, 200 rpm), centrifuge the culture, wash the pellet with sterile distilled water, resuspend in the original volume, adjust to ≈5 × 10⁸ CFU mL⁻¹, and dilute 1:10 with sterile water.

steps.title: Overlay sensitive suspension on producer plates
steps.instruction: Pour 15 mL of the diluted sensitive suspension onto each PY‑Ca agar plate that already contains producer spots; after 15 min, pour the excess suspension into a glass beaker, then incubate the plates 48 h at 30 °C and examine for inhibition halos.

steps.title: Grow sensitive strain for simultaneous assay
steps.instruction: Inoculate the sensitive strain into PY‑Ca liquid medium and incubate 24 h at 30 °C with shaking at 200 rpm.

steps.title: Streak sensitive culture on agar
steps.instruction: Spread 20 µL of the sensitive broth (≈5 × 10⁷ CFU mL⁻¹) onto a solid PY‑Ca agar plate.

steps.title: Add producer inoculum to plate center
steps.instruction: Place 20 µL of producer cell suspension (5 × 10⁸ CFU mL⁻¹) at the center of the same plate.

steps.title: Incubate and assess simultaneous assay
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate 48 h at 30 °C; observe the presence of inhibition halos around the producer spot as evidence of antibacterial activity.
